findings.highlight: after Caster has disappeared
findings.evidenceJa: キャスター亡き後
findings.governingReading: after Caster’s death
findings.explanation: A stated death becomes disappearance.

findings.highlight: The monks, who have collapsed from an unknown cause, have left the mountain to leave the temple empty
findings.evidenceJa: 原因不明の病で倒れた僧たちは山を降り、本殿はもぬけの空
findings.governingReading: the monks felled by an unknown illness have descended the mountain, leaving the main hall empty
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s infinitive makes emptying the temple sound like the monks’ purpose rather than the result of their departure.

findings.highlight: nor monks can enter the place
findings.evidenceJa: 関係者ですら入る事は許されない
findings.governingReading: even associated personnel are not permitted to enter
findings.explanation: The closure’s scope is narrowed from all affiliated personnel to monks.

findings.highlight: This is a real stinker
findings.evidenceJa: 鼻が曲がるどころの話じゃねえな
findings.governingReading: this is beyond merely making one’s nose bend
findings.explanation: Lancer’s escalating rough idiom becomes a mild stock phrase.

findings.highlight: the place that should be desolate
findings.evidenceJa: 無人の筈の境内
findings.governingReading: the temple precinct that should be uninhabited
findings.explanation: Absence of people becomes a general mood and the precinct is unnamed.

findings.highlight: The sturdily-built man
findings.evidenceJa: 無駄のない屈強な肉体
findings.governingReading: a powerful body without a wasted line
findings.explanation: The visual combines strength with lean efficiency; the English keeps only a generic build and adds “man.”

findings.highlight: this is too crude
findings.evidenceJa: 醜悪さは以前より五割増
findings.governingReading: its ugliness is fifty percent worse than before
findings.explanation: A precise comic escalation and aesthetic judgment become generic crudeness.

findings.highlight: Her work was much more polished than this
findings.evidenceJa: これに比べればキャスターは上品だった
findings.governingReading: compared with this, Caster herself was refined
findings.explanation: Lancer contrasts the two presences as beings; mirror moon turns it into workmanship.

findings.highlight: Lancer looks around the temple
findings.evidenceJa: 無造作に境内を見回る
findings.governingReading: Lancer patrols the precinct casually and without apparent care
findings.explanation: The bait-like lack of concern in his movement disappears.

findings.highlight: His objectives are to gain information and to keep watch
findings.evidenceJa: 諜報、監視を主目的としたサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: a Servant assigned primarily to intelligence and surveillance
findings.explanation: The key fact that these are his prescribed main functions is weakened into general objectives.

findings.highlight: He is unwilling, but he cannot disobey his Master’s command
findings.evidenceJa: 本人はいたって不本意だが、マスターがそう命じたのならば仕方がない
findings.governingReading: he is deeply dissatisfied, but accepts that a Master’s order leaves no alternative
findings.explanation: Lancer’s chosen contractual discipline becomes inability to disobey.

findings.highlight: to accomplish the mission
findings.evidenceJa: 注文通りの結果を出す
findings.governingReading: to produce the result exactly as ordered
findings.explanation: His professional standard of exact delivery becomes generic completion.

findings.highlight: Damn, what a racket
findings.evidenceJa: キイキイキイキイうるせえこと
findings.governingReading: what an incessant kii-kii squealing
findings.explanation: The sound imitation and Lancer’s mocking irritation disappear.

findings.highlight: I thought Caster was the master of wind
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターは風使いと読んでた
findings.governingReading: he had read Caster as a wind-user
findings.explanation: A tactical inference becomes a grander assertion of elemental mastery.

findings.highlight: maybe she used water instead
findings.evidenceJa: 水気の女だったのかね
findings.governingReading: perhaps she was a woman of water or dampness
findings.explanation: Lancer’s gendered, figurative characterization becomes a spell-element claim.

findings.highlight: This place is crawling with leeches and spiders
findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛だの蛭だの陰湿な輩が多いが
findings.governingReading: there are many gloomy, underhanded sorts—spiders and leeches among them
findings.explanation: His animal insults for lurking enemies become literal vermin inhabiting the temple.

findings.highlight: ifthis is an ifthere is
findings.evidenceJa: 仮にもし仮に
findings.governingReading: if—purely hypothetically—there were
findings.explanation: mirror moon attempts to preserve the emphatic repetition but produces broken English.

findings.highlight: gives a speech as if to persuade a person who is not here
findings.evidenceJa: 言い聞かせるように演説する
findings.governingReading: delivers a speech as though pointedly addressing someone absent
findings.explanation: Lancer is baiting or lecturing the hidden listener, not trying to persuade them.

findings.highlight: it looks like it was raised by beasts deep within a mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 山奥で獣と暮らしていた面
findings.governingReading: it has the face of something that lived with beasts deep in the mountains
findings.explanation: Coexistence and Lancer’s facial insult become an inferred upbringing.

findings.highlight: a dirty sandworm
findings.evidenceJa: こ汚い砂虫
findings.governingReading: a filthy sand-insect
findings.explanation: The insult is narrowed into a particular fantasy creature.

findings.highlight: Three rays of light streak forth from the darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 闇の中無明より放たれた三条の凶器
findings.governingReading: three weapons launched from lightless darkness
findings.explanation: mirror moon calls the weapons rays of light and drops the intensified source of their unseen attack.

findings.highlight: struck down by Lancer’s lance
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーの一薙ぎによって払われた
findings.governingReading: swept aside by one stroke from Lancer
findings.explanation: The wielder’s single economical action becomes an action attributed to the weapon.

findings.highlight: a weapon to be thrown
findings.evidenceJa: 狙い撃つ事を主として作られた投擲短剣
findings.governingReading: a throwing dagger designed primarily for aimed attacks
findings.explanation: The weapon’s defining precision and design purpose disappear.

findings.highlight: at Lancer’s eyes and throat
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーの両目と喉笛を標的に、寸分の狂いもなく
findings.governingReading: aimed without the slightest deviation at both eyes and his windpipe
findings.explanation: The English drops both-eye specificity, anatomical precision, and perfect accuracy.

findings.highlight: In the darkness in front of Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: 暗い堂の中には、うっすらと
findings.governingReading: faintly visible inside the dark hall
findings.explanation: The exact interior position and barely visible reveal are lost.

findings.highlight: starts without a signal
findings.evidenceJa: 何の口上もなく始まった
findings.governingReading: begins without any opening declaration or exchange
findings.explanation: The absence of verbal ritual becomes absence of an external signal.

findings.highlight: Lacking human words, the white skull attacks Lancer with an inhuman shriek
findings.evidenceJa: 人語を知らぬのか、奇声のみをあげて
findings.governingReading: as though ignorant of human speech, it attacks while uttering only strange cries
findings.explanation: A tentative inference becomes fact, and an uncanny cry is labeled categorically nonhuman.

findings.highlight: daggers with a precision rivaling that of Archer
findings.evidenceJa: 短剣は、それこそアーチャーの弓に匹敵する
findings.governingReading: the daggers themselves rival Archer’s bow
findings.explanation: The source leaves the axis of equivalence broad; mirror moon invents precision as the sole basis.

findings.highlight: as he runs through the darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 闇に飛び交いながら
findings.governingReading: while flying back and forth through the darkness
findings.explanation: The attacker’s uncanny aerial motion becomes running.

findings.highlight: the daggers
findings.evidenceJa: 針の穴さえ通す髑髏の短剣
findings.governingReading: the skull’s daggers, accurate enough to pass through a needle’s eye
findings.explanation: The hyperbolic precision driving the tactical puzzle disappears.

findings.highlight: the daggers, fired accurately in between his swings
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に相手の急所に放つ短剣
findings.governingReading: daggers fired unerringly at a vital point, with ruby also evoking a blind spot
findings.explanation: The target’s lethality and the source’s layered vital-point/blind-spot language disappear.

findings.highlight: his hostility changes to a clear intent to kill
findings.evidenceJa: 髑髏の様子を伺っていただけの敵意が、確実に殺すものへ
findings.governingReading: hostility that had only watched the skull shifts into something that will kill with certainty
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the prior restraint and weakens the predatory transition.

findings.highlight: as a counter to Lancer’s [r]charge
findings.evidenceJa: 髑髏へと踏み込もうとしたランサーに合わせた
findings.governingReading: timed to intercept Lancer as he is about to step in toward the skull
findings.explanation: A precisely anticipatory counter is reduced to responding to a generic charge.

findings.highlight: with a slight swing of his spear
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの僅か槍の穂先を揺らしただけ
findings.governingReading: by moving only the spearhead the slightest amount
findings.explanation: The source emphasizes microscopic economy; mirror moon enlarges the motion to a swing of the whole weapon.

findings.highlight: the enemy comes to take his life
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの首を突きにくる槍兵
findings.governingReading: the spearman comes to thrust at its neck
findings.explanation: Concrete imminent anatomy becomes generic mortal danger.

findings.highlight: He throws a dagger at the small opening
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーの喉元へ短剣を撃ち放つ
findings.governingReading: it fires a dagger at Lancer’s throat through the slight opening
findings.explanation: The decisive target is omitted, making the counterattack’s danger unclear.

findings.highlight: He performs both actions in one motion
findings.evidenceJa: 動作は一呼吸、まったくの同時に行われた
findings.governingReading: the defense and counter occur within one breath, completely simultaneously
findings.explanation: The English loses both the breath measure and the explicit simultaneity.

findings.highlight: projectile weapons are useless against me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に飛び道具は上手くない
findings.governingReading: projectile weapons are a poor match against him or do not work well
findings.explanation: A bounded defensive advantage becomes absolute uselessness.

findings.highlight: his enemy, who is now hiding his face
findings.evidenceJa: 素顔を隠す“敵”
findings.governingReading: the enemy whose true face remains hidden
findings.explanation: The English implies a new deliberate act of concealment after the mask falls.

findings.highlight: A right hand covered in bandages
findings.evidenceJa: 包帯で封じられた右腕
findings.governingReading: a right arm bound or sealed in bandages
findings.explanation: Both anatomical extent and the suggestion of restraint or sealing are lost.

findings.highlight: A face still hidden by the darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 白い髑髏の面で隠した顔は闇に隠れて、未だ明確には見えなかった
findings.governingReading: the face concealed by the white skull mask remains obscured by darkness and cannot yet be seen clearly
findings.explanation: The two layers of concealment and provisional uncertainty collapse into darkness alone.

findings.highlight: His face is flat and utterly featureless
findings.evidenceJa: 無貌と言えるほど、凹凸のない造りではなかったか
findings.governingReading: was the face not constructed with so little relief that it might be called faceless
findings.explanation: A tentative visual inference becomes categorical fact.

findings.highlight: his hostility is still emitting
findings.evidenceJa: 殺意は欠ける事なくランサーに向けられていた
findings.governingReading: its killing intent remains undiminished and directed at Lancer
findings.explanation: Precise lethal intent and direction become malformed, agentless hostility.

findings.highlight: You can’t hurt me using a projectile
findings.evidenceJa: その距離からの投擲はきかねえぞ
findings.governingReading: throws from that distance will not work on him
findings.explanation: The range condition disappears, making Lancer’s protection broader than stated.

findings.highlight: sinks down to the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛のように地に伏した瞬間
findings.governingReading: drops to the ground like a spider
findings.explanation: The movement loses the animal comparison tying the opponent’s style together.

findings.highlight: springs up in an instant
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく虚空に跳びあがった
findings.governingReading: leaps high into empty space
findings.explanation: Speed replaces height and the leap’s unnatural trajectory.

findings.highlight: his movements are those of a spider, snake, or scorpion
findings.evidenceJa: その歩法は蜘蛛か蛇、それとも蠍の類
findings.governingReading: its footwork is like that of a spider, snake, or scorpion
findings.explanation: A technical movement system becomes generic resemblance.

findings.highlight: Lancer’s charge is still the fastest
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーとて瞬発力では他の追随を許さない
findings.governingReading: in explosive acceleration Lancer allows no other to keep pace
findings.explanation: The specific attribute is reduced to a charge and asserted with an unsupported superlative.

findings.highlight: take even a minute
findings.evidenceJa: 分の刻を要する
findings.governingReading: require a span of minutes
findings.explanation: The unexpectedly prolonged pursuit is narrowed to one minute.

findings.highlight: It is a disgrace
findings.evidenceJa: あってはならない事だった
findings.governingReading: it was something that should not be possible
findings.explanation: A contradiction of Lancer’s expected ability becomes an emotional judgment of shame.

findings.highlight: I know I destroyed aimed for his throat
findings.evidenceJa: たしかに喉を狙ったんだが
findings.governingReading: he certainly aimed for the throat
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves an abandoned verb in active text, making the sentence grammatically broken.

findings.highlight: The enemy glides across the water like a spider
findings.evidenceJa: 水蜘蛛のように水面を滑る敵
findings.governingReading: the enemy glides over the surface like a water strider
findings.explanation: The locomotion simile becomes an ordinary spider moving on water.

findings.highlight: his speed is far greater
findings.evidenceJa: その速度は水蜘蛛などの及ぶところではない
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s speed lies far beyond any water strider’s reach
findings.explanation: The English leaves the possessor and comparison point unclear.

findings.highlight: I would’ve cut his joints
findings.evidenceJa: 付け根でも斬りつければよかった
findings.governingReading: he should have slashed the roots of the limbs
findings.explanation: The intended anatomical target changes from limb attachment points to joints.

findings.highlight: cut at the joint, where the main arteries lie
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ
findings.governingReading: cutting the major arteries at the roots of the limbs
findings.explanation: mirror moon recasts the source’s apposition as a universal anatomical claim about joints.

findings.highlight: As their lifeforce is magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 血液ではなく魔力を主動力とする彼ら
findings.governingReading: they use magical energy rather than blood as their primary motive power
findings.explanation: The explicit contrast with blood and mechanical “driving power” model disappear.

findings.highlight: The loss of a limb is another story, but cutting off a Servant’s limb is a difficult task. Disabling their limbs is another story, but stopping a Servant’s limb is a difficult task.
findings.evidenceJa: これが四肢の無力化になると話は別だが
findings.governingReading: incapacitating a limb is another matter
findings.explanation: mirror moon prints two overlapping attempts at the same sentence, creating a conspicuous duplicated corruption.

findings.highlight: The loss of a limb
findings.evidenceJa: 四肢の無力化
findings.governingReading: incapacitation of a limb
findings.explanation: Functional disablement becomes physical loss or amputation.

findings.highlight: cutting off a Servant’s limb is a difficult task
findings.evidenceJa: 易々と動きを封じられるサーヴァントはおるまい
findings.governingReading: no Servant would readily allow its movement to be sealed
findings.explanation: The opponent’s resistance to immobilization becomes only the difficulty of severing a limb.

findings.highlight: Hashish, huh? I bet a heroic spirit who relies on drugs
findings.evidenceJa: 成程。だが痛覚を殺す手に頼るような英霊に治癒能力などあるまい
findings.governingReading: I see; a Heroic Spirit relying on suppressed pain likely lacks healing ability
findings.explanation: mirror moon exposes an abandoned partial translation before restarting the sentence, creating unsupported hashish wording and duplicated dialogue.

findings.highlight: a pain-killer
findings.evidenceJa: 痛覚を殺す手
findings.governingReading: a method that kills or suppresses the sense of pain
findings.explanation: A technique or condition is narrowed into use of a medicinal painkiller.

findings.highlight: His next attack will strike in two more seconds
findings.evidenceJa: 次の打ち込みまであと二秒
findings.governingReading: two seconds remain until his next blow
findings.explanation: An interval until Lancer initiates his attack becomes a prediction that impact occurs then.

findings.highlight: thrusts at his fleeing enemy’s left leg
findings.evidenceJa: 左足大腿部を一閃しかけ
findings.governingReading: is about to slash once across the fleeing enemy’s left thigh
findings.explanation: Weapon action, anatomical target, and interrupted completion are weakened.

findings.highlight: Water explodes upward
findings.evidenceJa: 水面が跳ねる
findings.governingReading: the water’s surface leaps or splashes
findings.explanation: A restrained ominous motion becomes an explosion.

findings.highlight: Black tendrils
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い、うすっぺらな何か
findings.governingReading: some black, paper-thin thing
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the deliberately unidentified singular form with plural tentacles.

findings.highlight: something beneath the water is snarling
findings.evidenceJa: 水面に潜んでいたモノが牙をむく
findings.governingReading: the thing hidden beneath the surface bares its fangs
findings.explanation: A visual predatory action becomes a sound.

findings.highlight: reaching for the spearman
findings.evidenceJa: 虚空に跳び退くランサーを追っていく
findings.governingReading: pursues Lancer as he leaps backward into open air
findings.explanation: The target’s airborne escape and the black thing’s pursuit are omitted.

findings.highlight: Is it because this creature dwells underwater? It seems to resemble a deep-sea monster
findings.evidenceJa: 水面、という事もあるからか。その様は、深海に棲むという古代の海獣を連想させた
findings.governingReading: perhaps because it is on the water’s surface, the sight evokes an ancient sea beast said to dwell in the deep
findings.explanation: A narrator’s contextual association becomes a claim that the present creature lives underwater and physically resembles the beast.

findings.highlight: He instantly carves all his runes on the bottom of the lake
findings.evidenceJa: 槍で水面を抉り、所有する全てのルーンを湖底に刻む
findings.governingReading: he gouges the water’s surface with his spear and inscribes every rune he possesses on the lakebed
findings.explanation: The spear action, surface violence, and totality of his rune resources are weakened.

findings.highlight: it is easily penetrated
findings.evidenceJa: それさえも容易く侵食されていく
findings.governingReading: even that barrier is progressively and easily eroded
findings.explanation: A continuing consumption process becomes completed penetration.

findings.highlight: dark tentacles are closing in
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い足に囲まれ
findings.governingReading: surrounded by black legs or limbs
findings.explanation: The recurring deliberately bodily image is normalized into tentacles.

findings.highlight: a great Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: 上級宝具の一撃
findings.governingReading: a blow from an upper-rank Noble Phantasm
findings.explanation: A technical rank claim becomes generic praise.

findings.highlight: does not even slow down the penetration
findings.evidenceJa: 足止めにさえならない
findings.governingReading: cannot even hold the encroaching limbs back
findings.explanation: The agent and movement are replaced by an abstract “penetration.”

findings.highlight: Watching Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: それを
findings.governingReading: at that sight, Assassin mocks him
findings.explanation: A fragment left before the dialogue creates a dangling participial construction.

findings.highlight: these tendrils must engulf anything they can reach
findings.evidenceJa: この黒い足は誰であろうと侵食するのか
findings.governingReading: the black limbs appear to erode anyone without exception
findings.explanation: The source’s universal victim relation and corrosive action become a reach-limited swallowing behavior.

findings.highlight: I sHaLL KiLL YoU
findings.evidenceJa: オマエヲ打倒シ
findings.governingReading: defeat Lancer
findings.explanation: Assassin’s statement of overcoming Lancer is translated as a second explicit killing claim.

findings.highlight: But is it not meaningless?
findings.evidenceJa: それでは無意味だ
findings.governingReading: that is therefore meaningless
findings.explanation: Narratorial tactical certainty becomes a question.

findings.highlight: easily jump across such a distance
findings.evidenceJa: 容易く、一息で跳躍できる
findings.governingReading: can easily leap it in a single breath
findings.explanation: The measure emphasizing Lancer’s explosive escape capacity disappears.

findings.highlight: Lancer crouches low and braces his lance against the ground
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーの体が沈み、その槍が大きくたわむ
findings.governingReading: Lancer’s body sinks and his spear bends deeply
findings.explanation: The English supplies a conventional vault setup but loses the weapon’s loaded flex.

findings.highlight: He is struck by the simplest of attacks
findings.evidenceJa: シンプルな“一撃”が放たれた
findings.governingReading: an extraordinarily simple “strike” is unleashed
findings.explanation: The attack’s launch becomes a completed hit and removes the suspense over its mechanism.

findings.highlight: gouged out Lancer’s heart
findings.evidenceJa: 槍兵の胸をあばいてみせた
findings.governingReading: demonstrated directly laying open the spearman’s chest
findings.explanation: The staging of the remote curse at his chest is collapsed into physical extraction of the actual heart.

findings.highlight: the purest magic
findings.evidenceJa: 最も純粋な魔術
findings.governingReading: the purest magecraft
findings.explanation: A technical category becomes generic supernatural power.

findings.highlight: The surface boils
findings.evidenceJa: 水面が踊る
findings.governingReading: the water’s surface dances
findings.explanation: The grotesque animation changes from frantic movement to heat-like boiling.

findings.highlight: such a gruesome meal sight
findings.evidenceJa: これほど凄惨な光景
findings.governingReading: a spectacle this ghastly
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts “meal” into an already metaphorically framed comparison and produces unnatural English.

findings.highlight: Numerous black limbs
findings.evidenceJa: 無数の、黒い手足だけのモノ
findings.governingReading: countless things consisting only of black arms and legs
findings.explanation: The consumers’ status as entities made solely of limbs is reduced to loose appendages.

findings.highlight: The faceless Servant standing in the black water
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い湖面に浮かぶ無貌のサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: the faceless Servant floating on the black lake surface
findings.explanation: Floating above the surface becomes standing within the water.

findings.highlight: swallows the heart something red out of his prey with satisfaction
findings.evidenceJa: 赤いソレを満足げに飲み込んだ
findings.governingReading: satisfiedly swallows that red thing
findings.explanation: mirror moon exposes overlapping translation alternatives, specifies the oblique object as a heart, and invents extraction “out of his prey.”
